redistribution_statuses.description: Metadata can be stored locally and redistributed with source attribution.
Derived metadata tables can be stored and shared, but raw payloads or full text may require source-specific review.
Public-domain text can be stored locally and used for analysis.
Material may be stored or indexed locally for analysis, but redistribution requires review.
Only metadata should be stored or redistributed.
Access, robots, license, or source terms need review before ingest.

quote_statuses.description: Short quotations can be used under source license or ordinary public web citation norms.
Use metadata only; do not quote stored text.
